newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 9.0/10.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 9.0/10.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 9.0/10.0 percent on Thursday morning on the back of ample supply, dealers said.
One state bank dealer said early central bank injection of some 235 billion rupiah and carry-forward liquidity seemed to have kept the market afloat.
Dealers said operators were already seeking placement in overnight central bank papers (SBIs) in the morning which may indicate some oversupply at present.
The state bank dealer said operators still had a few more days to go before the next liquidity report on September 23.
Dealers said longer-term money market rates were stable, with one-month money quoted at 14.25/14.50 and three-month money at 15.00/15.25 percent.
The average overnight interbank rate on Wednesday was 10.44 percent, compared with 14.01 percent on Tuesday.
